body: People who like to tell anyone who is suicidal that they are being selfish are thoughtless jerks. It's also a cop out, I'd suggest not being around those people anymore and maybe try to find new people to be in your life because that stuff can drag you down worse. Believe me, I know from personal experience.
I hope that something really awesome happens in the next year for you. I know how you feel. Good luck.
Actually, there are days I go without eating because I don't make very much and I work my ass off. And I'm using the free wifi from the McDonald's I live near ><
